info.title: BudgetFlow API
info.description: Corporate budget delegation and control. Money is integer minor units with ISO 4217 codes; errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

amount.description: In the parent's or the child's budget currency; converted at the locked plan rate.

type.description: Exchange-rate type. Budget control always uses the plan rate locked for the fiscal year.

value.description: Cross rate with 12 decimals; amounts were converted with exactly this value.

rateIds.description: Source exchange-rate rows (empty when no conversion was needed).

AppliedRate.description: The exchange rate applied to convert a transaction amount.

issuer.description: OpenID Connect issuer (the Keycloak realm URL).

clientId.description: Public client of the web app (authorization code with PKCE).

AuthConfigResponse.description: Where the web app signs users in.

budgetCurrency.description: Bucket balances in the budget currency (natural sign).

reporting.description: Bucket balances in the reporting currency at the locked plan rate.

available.description: authorized − counted buckets per the control basis, budget currency.

allocationAvailable.description: What can still be allocated to children (allocated out always counts, no tolerance).

path.description: Materialized path of ancestor ids, root first.

allowedActions.description: Actions the current user may take on this budget (from PolicyService).

BudgetDetail.description: A budget with its ledger-derived balances.

BudgetList.description: Budgets visible to the user, cursor-paginated.

labelBy.description: Monthly calendars: label the year by the calendar year it starts or ends in.

method.description: Weekly calendars: last such weekday of the month, or nearest the month end.

CalendarDefinition.description: Calendar year, non-calendar year (any start month), or 52/53-week 4-4-5, 4-5-4, 5-4-4 and 13-period.

id.description: Generated by the client; a retried event with the same id is stored once.

occurredAt.description: Client time; the server uses its own time when this is missing, more than a day old or in the future.

id.description: Generated by the client; a retried event with the same id is stored once.

occurredAt.description: Client time; the server uses its own time when this is missing, more than a day old or in the future.

route.description: Route template of the page, e.g. /budgets/:budgetId.

ClientAnalyticsEvent.description: A web event with exactly the properties its name allows.

mode.description: hard blocks, soft warns, track only records.

toleranceBps.description: Spend tolerance in basis points of authorized.

deactivateFrom.description: Last active day is the day before.

costCenterId.description: Required on leaf budgets that take spend (Phase 4 enforces at first commitment).

planVersionId.description: Required for a root budget: the approved plan version it ties to.

originalAmount.description: Root budgets only: the original authorized amount in the budget currency.

CreateBudgetRequest.description: Create a root budget (posts the original budget journal) or an empty child budget.

code.description: Business code: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 50).

rateType.description: Exchange-rate type. Budget control always uses the plan rate locked for the fiscal year.

rate.description: Units of quote per one reporting-currency unit.

groupCalendarId.description: Map this entity calendar to the group calendar.

code.description: Business code: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 50).

attendeeType.description: Employee events and client entertainment map to different GL accounts.

effectiveFrom.description: The current mapping, if any, ends the day before.

code.description: Business code: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 50).

status.description: Blocked vendors cannot be used for new commitments (enforced from Phase 7).

legalEntityId.description: Null applies to every legal entity.

DoaLookupResponse.description: Which limit applies to an approver for a spend type, entity and amount.

DoaMatrix.description: The active delegation-of-authority matrix (read-only in Phase 3; enforced Phase 5, administered Phase 7).

rateType.description: Exchange-rate type. Budget control always uses the plan rate locked for the fiscal year.

rate.description: Units of quote per one base, up to 12 decimals.

status.description: Open accepts postings; soft-closed finance adjustments only; closed and locked none.

allowedActions.description: Status changes the caller may make now.

FiscalYearPreview.description: Generated periods for one fiscal year (nothing saved).

FiscalYearRef.description: A fiscal year of the tenant's group calendar.

attendeeType.description: Employee events and client entertainment map to different GL accounts.

csv.description: Columns: location_code, team_code (optional), employment_type, headcount, prorated_headcount (optional).

accepted.description: False when any line has an issue; nothing is saved then.

rowsRead.description: Data rows in the file (valid and invalid).

locations.description: Totals per location in the file, with the previous snapshot.

previousHeadcount.description: Same unit in the previous snapshot.

scope.description: What the caller sees: the whole tenant, the subtrees of their org scope, or only their own units.

HeadcountSummary.description: Latest headcount snapshot on or before the date, by location and team.

previousHeadcount.description: Same unit in the previous snapshot.

ImportIssue.description: A problem on one line of an uploaded file (header is line 1).

childrenAuthorizedAtPlanMinor.description: Children's authorized valued in the parent currency at the locked plan rate.

IntegrityCheckRun.description: A ledger rebuild check run by the worker: rebuilt balances versus cached ones, journal balance, non-negative buckets, allocated out within authorized, per-line currency triplets, hierarchy at the plan rate, plan tie-out and the audit chain.

late.description: Posted to the next open period because its own period was closed.

account.description: Budget bucket or tenant-level counter account.

LedgerLine.description: One append-only ledger line carrying the currency triplet.

LegalEntity.description: A legal entity: functional currency, fiscal calendar, tax jurisdiction, ERP code.

account.description: Budget bucket or tenant-level counter account.

legalEntityId.description: Counter-account lines only; budget lines use the budget legal entity.

ManualJournalRequest.description: Opening balances and adjustments to commitment, actual and accrual buckets (finance admins).

locationName.description: Name of the person's location org unit.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for showing timestamps: the person's own, else their location's, else the tenant default.

permissions.description: Actions the user may take somewhere in this tenant (from PolicyService). The web hides what is missing; the API enforces.

platformOperator.description: Super Admin without an active break-glass grant: no access to tenant financial data.

fiscalYears.description: Fiscal years of the tenant's group calendar, oldest first.

MeResponse.description: The signed-in user in the selected tenant, with every tenant they belong to.

amountMinor.description: Amount in integer minor units of the currency (cents for USD, yen for JPY, fils for KWD).

Money.description: A money amount in integer minor units with its ISO 4217 code.

csv.description: Columns: code, name, kind, parent_code, legal_entity_code (optional), timezone (optional).

ancestorIds.description: Ancestors from the root down to this unit (inclusive).

peopleCount.description: People whose location or team is this unit.

OrgUnit.description: An org unit as of the requested date.

effectiveFrom.description: The day the change takes effect (after any earlier change).

deactivate.description: Close the unit from the effective date.

OrgUnitChangeRequest.description: An effective-dated change: rename, move, change manager or deactivate.

ancestorIds.description: Ancestors from the root down to this unit (inclusive).

peopleCount.description: People whose location or team is this unit.

OrgUnitDetail.description: An org unit with its history, children, cost centers and latest headcount.

scope.description: What the caller sees: the whole tenant, the subtrees of their org scope, or only their own units.

OrgUnitList.description: Org units visible to the caller as of a date, parents before children.

OrgUnitVersion.description: One effective-dated version of an org unit.

Person.description: A person in the directory (fictional seed data).

scope.description: What the caller sees: the whole tenant, the subtrees of their org scope, or only their own units.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; the UI branches on it.

detail.description: Plain-English explanation safe to show to the user.

type.description: Exchange-rate type. Budget control always uses the plan rate locked for the fiscal year.

RateLookupResponse.description: The rate that applies on a date for a rate type, and an optional conversion.

ReadinessResponse.description: Readiness: database and Keycloak JWKS reachable.

RecordAnalyticsRequest.description: A batch of product analytics events from the web app.

ReportingLineChangeRequest.description: Effective-dated manager change; the current solid line closes the day before.

UpdateLegalEntityRequest.description: Functional currency and fiscal calendar are fixed once an entity exists (they drive postings).
